name: Pragati Scholarship Scheme
description: Scholarship support for meritorious girls pursuing technical education in India.
beneficiaries: Girl students in technical education
eligibility_summary: Open to meritorious girl students studying engineering and technical courses at selected institutions.
required_documents: Academic certificate, institution details, bank account details, and supporting identity documents.
source_passage: The scheme provides financial assistance to meritorious girls pursuing technical education and is listed on the National Scholarship Portal.

name: PM Udaan Yojana
description: Support for students preparing for management and higher study entrance examinations.
beneficiaries: Students preparing for entrance exams
eligibility_summary: Applicable to eligible students as defined by the scheme's official notification and participating institutions.
required_documents: Application form, identity proof, academic records, and supporting documents specified by the implementing body.
source_passage: The scheme is a public welfare initiative for students preparing for management entrance examinations.

name: Skill India / Atma Nirbhar Bharat Training Support
description: Training and upskilling opportunities for youth and unemployed persons in market-relevant skills.
beneficiaries: Youth, unemployed persons, and working individuals seeking skill development
eligibility_summary: Eligibility varies by training programme and implementing agency; applicants should check official programme details.
required_documents: Identity proof, basic educational documents, and required training forms when specified.
source_passage: Skill India promotes digital and vocational skill development through public programmes, training centres, and recognitions.

name: PM-KISAN
description: Direct income support to eligible farmer families to help with agricultural and household expenses.
beneficiaries: Small and marginal farmer families
eligibility_summary: Targeted to eligible farmer families as per official eligibility rules and land records.
required_documents: Land records, identity proof, and bank account details where applicable.
source_passage: PM-KISAN provides direct income support to eligible farmer families through a public transfer mechanism.

name: Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS)
description: Nutrition and early childhood support services for children, pregnant women, and lactating mothers.
beneficiaries: Children, pregnant women, and nursing mothers
eligibility_summary: Services are generally available through local Anganwadi centres under official state and central welfare programmes.
required_documents: Residence proof, child information, and local registration documents as needed by the implementing centre.
source_passage: ICDS programmes support maternal and child health, nutrition, and early childhood development across local service centres.

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
description: Health insurance coverage for eligible families for secondary and tertiary care treatments.
beneficiaries: Eligible families and beneficiaries in need of hospital care
eligibility_summary: Coverage is identified through official beneficiary eligibility and available state implementation tools.
required_documents: Identity proof, family details, and scheme-related verification documents as directed by the issuing authority.
source_passage: Ayushman Bharat provides health coverage support aimed at reducing the financial burden of hospital treatment for eligible families.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana
description: Housing support for eligible rural and urban households through different implementation channels.
beneficiaries: Rural and urban households eligible under the scheme criteria
eligibility_summary: Eligibility depends on official criteria, local implementation, and household verification.
required_documents: Identity proof, residence proof, income documents, and supporting forms as required by the local authority.
source_passage: PMAY aims to expand access to affordable housing through central and state implementation frameworks.

name: PM SVANidhi
description: Street vendor support including working capital and digital payments assistance.
beneficiaries: Street vendors and urban informal traders
eligibility_summary: Eligibility is based on vendor registration, location, and verification under official programme terms.
required_documents: Vendor certificate or identity proof, local address proof, and programme registration documents.
source_passage: PM SVANidhi supports street vendors with working capital and digital payment support under defined programme rules.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
description: Access to basic banking services and financial inclusion through zero-balance accounts.
beneficiaries: Unbanked and underbanked households
eligibility_summary: Open to eligible households through participating banks and official scheme guidelines.
required_documents: Identity proof, address information, and account opening forms through a bank branch.
source_passage: Jan Dhan accounts promote financial inclusion and access to basic banking services for eligible households.

name: Old Age and Pension Support
description: Financial assistance programmes for older citizens and vulnerable households.
beneficiaries: Senior citizens and eligible vulnerable people
eligibility_summary: Eligibility depends on the specific scheme and the implementing state or central authority.
required_documents: Age proof, identity documents, and official beneficiary forms as required by the scheme.
source_passage: Pension support schemes often provide income assistance to older citizens and vulnerable households through local administration channels.

name: Citizen Service and Public Services Access
description: Government public service portals that help citizens access information, grievance support, and public records.
beneficiaries: General public seeking public information and administrative support
eligibility_summary: Public services are usually available to citizens through official digital portals and service centres.
required_documents: Varies by service and may include identity, address, or document proof.
source_passage: Public service portals provide useful guidance to citizens seeking official information and administrative support.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme
description: Financial assistance intended to encourage eligible students to continue secondary education.
beneficiaries: Eligible students studying at the secondary level
eligibility_summary: Eligibility and selection are governed by the current official scholarship notification and state implementation process.
required_documents: Academic records, identity details, bank account information, and documents requested by the implementing authority.
source_passage: The National Scholarship Portal publishes information about centrally supported scholarships and their application processes.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
description: Skill training and certification opportunities delivered through approved training partners.
beneficiaries: Indian youth seeking industry-relevant training
eligibility_summary: Eligibility, available courses, and assessment requirements vary by the active programme and training centre.
required_documents: Identity proof, contact details, and enrolment information requested by the training centre.
source_passage: PMKVY supports skill development through training, assessment, and certification under current programme guidelines.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Soil testing and advisory information to help farmers make informed nutrient-management decisions.
beneficiaries: Farmers seeking soil health information
eligibility_summary: Testing and advisory access depends on the local agriculture department and currently available service channels.
required_documents: Farmer details, land information, and records requested by the local agriculture office.
source_passage: The Soil Health Card programme provides farmers with soil test results and nutrient-management recommendations.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Account
description: A government-backed savings account intended to support the future education and financial needs of a girl child.
beneficiaries: Guardians and families saving for an eligible girl child
eligibility_summary: Account opening and operating rules are governed by the current official scheme and post-office or bank requirements.
required_documents: Girl child birth certificate, guardian identity documents, address proof, and account forms as required.
source_passage: Sukanya Samriddhi is a small savings option for the education and future needs of an eligible girl child.

name: National Health Mission
description: Public health programmes supporting accessible, affordable, and quality healthcare services.
beneficiaries: Communities served through public health facilities
eligibility_summary: Specific services and eligibility vary by programme, state, and local public health facility.
required_documents: Documents vary by the service; users should confirm requirements with the relevant health facility.
source_passage: The National Health Mission coordinates public health initiatives and service delivery through central and state programmes.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin
description: Rural housing assistance for eligible households identified through the official rural housing process.
beneficiaries: Eligible rural households requiring housing support
eligibility_summary: Selection depends on official rural household data, local verification, and current programme guidelines.
required_documents: Identity, residence, household, and local verification records as requested by the implementing authority.
source_passage: PMAY-G supports rural households through an official process for identifying and assisting eligible beneficiaries.

name: Stand-Up India
description: Institutional credit support intended to encourage entrepreneurship among eligible borrowers.
beneficiaries: Eligible women and Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe entrepreneurs
eligibility_summary: Loan eligibility, project conditions, and documentation are subject to the current official lending guidelines.
required_documents: Business plan, identity and address proof, financial information, and bank-requested documents.
source_passage: Stand-Up India facilitates bank loans for eligible entrepreneurs starting or expanding greenfield enterprises.

name: National Social Assistance Programme
description: Social assistance support delivered through centrally sponsored pension and family benefit components.
beneficiaries: Eligible older persons, widows, persons with disabilities, and vulnerable households
eligibility_summary: Eligibility and payment processes vary by component and implementing state or local authority.
required_documents: Age, identity, residence, income, and beneficiary records as required by the relevant authority.
source_passage: NSAP provides social assistance through a set of pension and family benefit programmes implemented with state participation.

name: MyGov Citizen Engagement
description: A citizen engagement platform for public consultations, discussions, and information about government initiatives.
beneficiaries: Citizens seeking public engagement and government information
eligibility_summary: Participation opportunities depend on the activity and the terms displayed on the official platform.
required_documents: Requirements vary by activity; users should follow the instructions on the official platform.
source_passage: MyGov provides a platform for citizen participation, public consultations, and information about government initiatives.
